title: AHB Read, Write, Wait, and Error Completion
description: Follow who drives HWDATA and HRDATA, then inspect the two-cycle AHB-Lite ERROR response qualified by HREADY and HRESP.

annotations.message: Read data phase for address 0x100: the slave drives HRDATA=0xBEEF while the master presents the next write address.
Write data phase for address 0x104: the master drives HWDATA=0xCAFE while the error-producing read address is issued.
First ERROR cycle: the slave asserts HRESP and drives HREADY LOW, extending the failing transfer.
Second ERROR cycle: HRESP remains asserted and HREADY returns HIGH, so the master samples error completion on this edge.
